ASTIS-authored actual compact-C2 Gaussian/count observer and entropy integration independently sealed before proof.
For every real C2 function f with compact support, the actual variance-one centered Gaussian integrates f squared, f squared times log(f squared), and the square of its real derivative. Each actual normalized Bool counting measure integrates those same functions of the signed sum divided by sqrt(N), including N=0. Their positive-index (N+1) count integrals converge respectively to the Gaussian integrals. The corresponding homogeneous entropy, including zero mass, converges to the Gaussian homogeneous entropy. All domains and limits are produced internally.
Exact scope: Authored compact C2 scalar core: same actual allN Bool count/card/signed sqrt-normalized sum and variance-one Gaussian. Three Gaussian L1 plus allN three actual-count L1 domains and successor mass/log-energy/derivative-square/entropy integral limits are produced internally. No supplied law/domain/limit certificate, normalization or positive mass premise. Fullflip-energy factor4, GaussianLSI, finiteHilbert/noncompact actual sqrtRN cutoff, T2/FIRST4.6/main/work/composition remain open.
theorem compact_count_gaussian_entropy_limits
    (f : ℝ → ℝ) (hf : ContDiff ℝ 2 f) (hs : HasCompactSupport f) :
    let μ : (n : ℕ) → Measure (Fin n → Bool) := fun n =>
      (Fintype.card (Fin n → Bool) : ℝ≥0∞)⁻¹ • Measure.count
    let S : (n : ℕ) → (Fin n → Bool) → ℝ := fun n ε =>
      (Real.sqrt (n : ℝ))⁻¹ * ∑ j : Fin n, if ε j then (1 : ℝ) else -1
    let γ : Measure ℝ := gaussianReal 0 1
    Integrable (fun x => (f x)^2) γ ∧
    Integrable (fun x => (f x)^2 * Real.log ((f x)^2)) γ ∧
    Integrable (fun x => (deriv f x)^2) γ ∧
    (∀ n : ℕ,
      Integrable (fun ε => (f (S n ε))^2) (μ n) ∧
      Integrable (fun ε => (f (S n ε))^2 * Real.log ((f (S n ε))^2)) (μ n) ∧
      Integrable (fun ε => (deriv f (S n ε))^2) (μ n)) ∧
    Tendsto (fun n : ℕ => ∫ ε, (f (S (n+1) ε))^2 ∂μ (n+1)) atTop
      (𝓝 (∫ x, (f x)^2 ∂γ)) ∧
    Tendsto (fun n : ℕ => ∫ ε,
      (f (S (n+1) ε))^2 * Real.log ((f (S (n+1) ε))^2) ∂μ (n+1)) atTop
      (𝓝 (∫ x, (f x)^2 * Real.log ((f x)^2) ∂γ)) ∧
    Tendsto (fun n : ℕ => ∫ ε, (deriv f (S (n+1) ε))^2 ∂μ (n+1)) atTop
      (𝓝 (∫ x, (deriv f x)^2 ∂γ)) ∧
    Tendsto (fun n : ℕ =>
      (∫ ε, (f (S (n+1) ε))^2 * Real.log ((f (S (n+1) ε))^2) ∂μ (n+1)) -
      (∫ ε, (f (S (n+1) ε))^2 ∂μ (n+1)) *
        Real.log (∫ ε, (f (S (n+1) ε))^2 ∂μ (n+1))) atTop
      (𝓝 ((∫ x, (f x)^2 * Real.log ((f x)^2) ∂γ) -
        (∫ x, (f x)^2 ∂γ) * Real.log (∫ x, (f x)^2 ∂γ)))

For every real-valued function f on the real line that is C2 and has compact support, define, for each natural number n (including n = 0), the finite space Omega_n = {epsilon : Fin n -> Bool}, the measure mu_n = (card(Omega_n) : ENNReal)^(-1) times counting measure, and S_n(epsilon) = (sqrt(n : Real))^(-1) times sum over j : Fin n of (1 if epsilon(j) is true, and -1 otherwise). Let gamma = gaussianReal 0 1, the real Gaussian probability measure of mean 0 and variance 1, and let f' denote the real derivative deriv f.
The three real functions x -> f(x)^2, x -> f(x)^2 log(f(x)^2), and x -> f'(x)^2 are Bochner integrable against gamma. For every natural n, their compositions with S_n are Bochner integrable against mu_n.
Write A_n = integral over Omega_n of f(S_n(epsilon))^2 dmu_n, B_n = integral over Omega_n of f(S_n(epsilon))^2 log(f(S_n(epsilon))^2) dmu_n, and D_n = integral over Omega_n of f'(S_n(epsilon))^2 dmu_n. Write A = integral over Real of f(x)^2 dgamma, B = integral over Real of f(x)^2 log(f(x)^2) dgamma, and D = integral over Real of f'(x)^2 dgamma. As n tends to infinity through the natural numbers, A_(n+1) tends to A, B_(n+1) tends to B, D_(n+1) tends to D, and B_(n+1) - A_(n+1) log(A_(n+1)) tends to B - A log(A), all as scalar convergence in Real.
The inverse of zero is zero and the Fin 0 sum is empty, so S_0 = 0 on the singleton space Omega_0; the all-n integrability conclusion includes this case, while the limit sequences use n+1. Real.log is totalized with log(0) = 0, including at zeros of f and at zero mass A_n or A. No positivity, density normalization, integrability certificate, or limit certificate for f is an extra hypothesis.
